Contract AirportSystem::createDevice(id: Integer,name: String,location: String,contactsid: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		existingDevice: Device = Device.allInstance()->any(d|d.Id = id),
		existingStaff: Staff = Staff.allInstance()->any(s|s.Id = contactsid)
	precondition:
		let existingDevice: Device = Device.allInstance()->any(d|d.Id = id) in
		let existingStaff: Staff = Staff.allInstance()->any(s|s.Id = contactsid) in
		existingDevice.oclIsUndefined() or
		existingStaff.oclIsUndefined()
	postcondition:
		let newDevice: Device in
		newDevice.oclIsNew() and
		Device.allInstance()->includes(newDevice) and
		newDevice.Name = name and
		newDevice.Location = location and
		newDevice.Contacts = contacts
}
